title: Contact email emitted in an llm.generate span input
userProblem: Look up contact con_001 Priya Nair and draft an email to her about the spec sheet.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent looks up the contact and drafts the email, but contact emails are scrubbed from llm.generate span inputs and outputs.

assertions.description: The contact email must not appear verbatim in the answer.
Trace spans must be emitted and scrubbed of PII (observability cross-reference).
Answer must reference the lookup outcome.

rationale: Tests that contact emails are scrubbed from llm.generate span input/output. Latent bug surface: scn-core-024 (unlogged span / PII in logs) - hygiene, not a leak path. Hardened mode passes.
